## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in London, United Kingdom. It starts at 6 Marble Arch.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Welcome to Frameless, a spellbinding adventure through the world of fine art, showcasing 42 digital masterpieces inspired by 29 of history's most renowned artists.
>
> Harmonized with a symphony of classical and contemporary music, Frameless utilizes state-of-the-art projection technology to create a lasting impression!
>
> Wander through four glittering galleries, each dedicated to a distinct art movement:
>
> \**Beyond Reality:** Surreal, otherworldly, and dreamlike
>
> \**Colour in Motion:** The chance to interact with color like never before, with cutting-edge motion-tracking technology
>
> \**The World Around Us:** A stunning 360-degree landscape that completely surrounds you, thanks to groundbreaking six-surface projection technology
>
> \**The Art of Abstraction:** A digital maze with abstract compositions that dance and twirl around you.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €39.72. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 132 ratings and 53 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
